### Turmeric Wound Healer 100g | Traditional Ayurvedic Skin Care Paste | Natural Botanical Blend

Falcon Herbs Turmeric Wound Healer is a time-honored Ayurvedic preparation crafted with organic turmeric root and a selection of gentle, plant-based ingredients traditionally valued in holistic wellness rituals. This soothing, earthy paste is intended for external use and reflects centuries of Ayurvedic practice — where nature’s offerings are thoughtfully combined to support daily care routines.

#### Traditional Applications & Usage
- Formulated for external application on minor skin surface areas
- Used in traditional practices to maintain a clean, calming environment for the skin
- Blended with botanicals long respected in Ayurvedic daily rituals
- Designed to complement gentle skin care routines with natural ingredients
- Suitable for use on humans and pets — always perform a patch test prior to use

Made without synthetic additives, parabens, or artificial fragrances, this 100g jar offers a pure, plant-based option for those who appreciate traditional formulations. Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight to preserve its natural qualities.

At Falcon Herbs, we honor the ancient rhythms of Ayurveda — where simplicity, intention, and botanical wisdom guide every blend.
